items.title: Romualdez appeals 90-day suspension order

items.title: Marcos wants multisector nutrition project sustained

items.title: Senate cuts P19.8 billion budget for 2 ayuda programs
items.description: The Senate has slashed P19.8 billion from two major cash aid programs to raise the subsidy for Philippine Health Insurance Corp. to P94.2 billion under the proposed national budget for next year, Senate finance committee chairman JV Ejercito said yesterday.

items.title: After 12 years, man receives P12.3 million lotto jackpot
items.description: A man who spent more than a decade fighting for his P12.39-million lotto jackpot received his prize yesterday, despite his winning ticket having been partially burned by a flat iron.

items.title: Education curriculum includes CPR, first aid
items.description: Life-saving cardiopulmonary resuscitation, first aid and basic life support training have been integrated across the basic education curriculum to equip students with the confidence and skills needed to assist in emergencies, the Department of Education said yesterday.

items.title: Flood control back; House vows no ghost, substandard projects
